sections.changelog:
1.7.1

  • Lawyer mini-site polish: the profile hero shows the dedicated portrait instead of the wide banner when card_photo_id exists; social share image for profiles is the portrait instead of the site logo; the floating WhatsApp bar on profiles names the lawyer in the prefill; /contact-us/ 301s to the live /contact/ page.

1.7.0

  • Professional cards redesigned to marketplace grade: gradient-border card with layered elevation, navy ribbon with gold flag label, conic gradient avatar ring with the geometry locked inline (aspect-ratio + object-fit survive any theme CSS), square-crop avatar source with retina srcset and a card_photo_id override meta, practice-area and city chips, verified license and experience trust row, 48px CTA pair with hierarchy, reduced-motion support. Second card requires a second lawyer and a minimum gap. Settings page: Settings > Justice Cards (enable, max, gap, colors, labels). Deploy hygiene: aggregates no longer wiped on upgrade.

1.6.2

  • Card styles print from wp_head: style tags inside post content are stripped by sanitization, so the cards rendered bare.

1.6.1

  • Cards resolve the page family from its own practice-areas terms first; candidates pass the theme public-approval gate; only profiles with a positive priority score float, keeping the score as the placement dial.

1.6.0

  • Professional cards: sponsored lawyer cards rendered inside articles, posts and encyclopedia entries by practice family, ranked by priority score with daily rotation among equals, rich mobile-first card with photo, areas, city, verified license badge, WhatsApp CTA carrying page and lawyer context, and profile link; admin options for enable and per-page cap.

1.5.1

  • WhatsApp prefill separators survive URL escaping.

1.5.0

  • Practice-area polish: hero description trimmed to intro with the full guide moved to a readable full-width section (no content loss), taxonomy archives capped at 24 cards per page; sitewide floating WhatsApp lead button carrying page title and URL in the prefilled message, big labeled bar on mobile.

1.4.2

  • News sitemap moved to /sitemap-news.xml (outside the Yoast rewrite pattern).

1.4.1

  • English news slugs (family-legal-news-date), government links wired into article briefs, sitemap rewrite reflush.

1.4.0

  • Legal news engine: hourly feed watcher over Israeli sources, family keyword routing, sourced value-add briefs with official government links, editorial cadence caps, Google News sitemap at /news-sitemap.xml, wp-admin Justice News control panel with pause switch, status endpoint.

1.3.6

  • Deterministic scrub of connector-type AI tellers before validation.

1.3.5

  • Quality hardening: deterministic markdown-to-HTML conversion, markdown residue fails validation, expanded AI-teller bans, FAQ h3 enforcement, in-place regeneration for published articles.

1.3.4

  • Per-section article generation: opening, one call per H2 with deterministic headings, FAQ block; expand pass kept as safety.

1.3.3

  • Articles lane writes in two structured parts (sections then sections+FAQ) for deterministic 1,500+ word depth.

1.3.2

  • Articles lane: dedicated model option (default gpt-4o) and a second expand pass to hold the 1,300-word floor.

1.3.1

  • Brief storage survives meta unslashing (Hebrew gershayim in statute years); intake repairs thin drafts in place.

1.3.0

  • Spoke articles lane: long-form money articles (1,500-2,200 words, floor 1,300 in code) from pre-approved briefs, one per day, English slugs, collision-checked, pillar-meshed in-body, Yoast meta set on publish.

1.2.1

  • Routing bridge: encyclopedia singles resolve correctly past the theme request guard; intake gives new entries Latin slugs from the English term.

1.2.0

  • Encyclopedia autolinker: first occurrences of published terms across articles, posts and pages link into the encyclopedia, capped at 4 per page, boundary-safe, never inside anchors or headings.

1.1.0

  • Self-writing legal encyclopedia: justice_term CPT, ontology intake, hourly OpenAI writer with tier floors and expand pass, drip scheduler, status telemetry, EN chip, disclaimer and DefinedTerm schema.
